description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView subclass called AttractionsRecyclerView that manages an empty view. The class provides functionality to display an empty view when no data is present in the adapter and hide it otherwise.

classes.name: AttractionsRecyclerView
classes.description: A subclass of RecyclerView that adds support for displaying an empty view when the adapter has no data.

methods.name: AttractionsRecyclerView
methods.description: Constructor matching the superclass, initializes the RecyclerView with a context.

methods.name: AttractionsRecyclerView
methods.description: Constructor with context and AttributeSet, for inflating from XML.

methods.name: AttractionsRecyclerView
methods.description: Constructor with context, AttributeSet, and default style, for inflating from XML.

methods.name: setEmptyView
methods.description: Assigns a view as the empty view to display when the adapter has no data.

methods.name: setAdapter
methods.description: Overrides the default setAdapter method to register and unregister data observers and to update empty view visibility.

methods.name: updateEmptyView
methods.description: Checks adapter item count and toggles visibility of the empty view and RecyclerView accordingly.
